name: Namespace Report
description: Lists namespaces with their pod counts and flags namespaces that have no owner label. Example of a plugin with a UI panel, a command and a custom assessment rule.
author: Soliton Rudder

assessmentRules.title: Namespaces without an owner label
assessmentRules.description: Every namespace should carry an `owner` or `team` label so incidents and costs can be routed to someone.
assessmentRules.remediation: Add a label, e.g. kubectl label namespace <name> owner=<team>.
